'''Vom Dresid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3638 BBY]] he was stationed on the [[Valor-class cruiser]] [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']], where he escorted an important figure to a private meeting with the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Dresid appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' during the introductory cutscene for the "Scum and Villainy" operation on Republic side.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
